CHANGELOG.RANGE.summary: Returns changelog entries of a volume in a sequence number range.
CHANGELOG.RANGE.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of entries read. N is at most the limit.

reply_schema.description: The changelog entries in ascending sequence number order, or in descending order with REVERSE.

versionstamp.description: Base32-hex encoded Versionstamp of the volume entry that the operation applies to.

before.description: Segment location before the operation. Present only for DELETE and UPDATE.

sequence_number.description: Sequence number of this changelog entry.

after.description: Segment location after the operation. Present only for APPEND, INSERT and UPDATE.

sequence_number.description: Sequence number of this changelog entry.

arguments.name: parent-operation-kind
arguments.summary: Filters entries by parent operation kind. LIFECYCLE matches APPEND, INSERT and UPDATE. FINALIZATION matches DELETE. Use * for all kinds.

arguments.name: start
arguments.summary: The start of the range. Use [N for an inclusive start or (N for an exclusive start.

arguments.name: end
arguments.summary: The end of the range. Use N] for an inclusive end or N) for an exclusive end. Must be greater than start.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.summary: The maximum number of entries to read. The parent operation kind filter is applied after this limit, so fewer entries can be returned. Defaults to 1000. A value less than 1 uses the default.

arguments.name: reverse
arguments.summary: Returns the entries in descending sequence number order.
